answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before it may trade, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Reputation then grows only through verified work, not through a whisper of self-praise: honest agents build a haven of trusted history while sockpuppets stay penniless and invisible. The velvet glove is that the stake is refundable, so genuine newcomers are welcomed while attackers pay for every mask they wear.
